name: Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the amended proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directive 1999/62/EC, Council Directive 1999/37/EC and Directive (EU) 2019/520 as regards the CO2 emission class of heavy-duty vehicles with trailers and clarifying and simplifying certain provisions
part_text:
The report sets out Parliament's position on how trucks and vans are charged for using roads, based on how much carbon dioxide they emit. It asks for changes so that converted electric trucks, trucks running on two fuels, and trucks with electric cooling units are treated more fairly. It also wants small vans up to 4.25 tonnes to count as light vehicles, and clearer rules so drivers are not charged more just because emission data is missing.

- Converted electric trucks and dual-fuel trucks get clearer emission classes, so toll discounts are fairer.
- Electric cooling units on trucks can get toll cuts; vans up to 4.25 tonnes count as light vehicles.
- Parliament adopted this position; talks with EU governments come next before it becomes law.
